notes.title: Version 1.08 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
v1.08

- [Cloaking Feather] item added to treasure chests throughout the game and to various Memory Orb vendors. This item causes random enemies on the map to ignore you for one minute.

- [Magical Harp] item added to New Game+.* This item can be used an unlimited amount of time and causes random enemies on the map to ignore you for one minute.
*If you are already in New Game+, simply return to the World Map to receive this item.

- A 'break' of 4 seconds has been added after each battle (both victory and escape), in which random enemies on the map will neither chase you nor notice you.

- Spelling error corrected in the Sewers.

- Passability of rubble in the Mighty Wizard's Castle fixed

notes.notes:

Hey everyone! Aaron here!
Exciting news: [b]『The Princess' Heart』[/b] has been released on Steam today!

This brand new fantasy adventure is just a single click away. ★
 Visit the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/378830]Steam store[/url] or click on the trailer below. 

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/378830][img]http://www.roseportalgames.com/files/pics/newsletter/newsletter_tph_02.png[/img][/url] 

[i]With a style inspired by Earthbound and Final Fantasy 3, The Princess' Heart features up to 15 hours of epic fantasy gameplay. Follow Princess Aerin on a quest to defeat her demons, both literal and metaphorical, in this light-hearted tale of hope and love.[/i]

[b]Features—[/b] 
  ★ Spells have an Area of Effect, so you must choose your target wisely! 
  ★ 8 unique playable characters! 
  ★ Up to 15 hours of gameplay! 
  ★ Open exploration of the entire world. 
  ★ A beautiful soundtrack of sweeping melodies and exciting battle tracks. 
★ Customize your characters' spells and skills. 

Just $4.99 and 10% launch discount! Grab it now[b]～[/b]!!
